text:
Maya: Weekend poll — torn between a 'Greenway Vinyl & Thrift Crawl' (plants + records!) or catching sunrise surf + bagels. Who's up? :thinking:
Sam: Vinyl crawl sounds amazing — plants + records :seedling: :record_player:
Chris: i'm in for thrift, need a new jacket. what time?
Tess: i'm tempted by surf but only if bagels are involved :bagel:
Maya: quick vote: react with ✅ for thrift+vinyl, react with ☀️ for surf. Thinking meetup logistics too.
Elena: ✅ thrift! also can carpool from Mission — i have room for 2
Sam: i can drive too, 10:30 pick up? @Elena you cool with 10:30? :car:
ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop garden seed swap Sat 9–11am — sign up: https://tiny.redwood/garden (auto reminder)
Tess: ☀️ tempted but prolly pass, early alarm :zzz:
Chris: if thrift, anyone up for a quick stop at Valence Vinyl on Valencia? they said small 10% sale this weekend.
Maya: sounds like thrift+vinyl is winning. Plan: meetup 10:30 at Mission lot, then 11am at 4th St market. I'll DM carpool list. @Tess maybe join for bagels after? :baguette_bread:
Sam: :thumbsup: see y'all!
